skills.name: LCD Conversion
skills.definition: Find the least common denominator of two unlike denominators and convert both fractions to equivalent fractions with that denominator.

skills.name: Whole/Fraction Decomposition & Subtraction
skills.definition: Separate a mixed or whole number into whole and fractional parts (treating a whole number as whole+0/d when needed) and subtract the whole parts and fractional parts independently.

skills.name: Borrowing
skills.definition: When subtracting fractional parts yields a negative value, regroup one unit from the whole part into the fraction (as denominator/denominator) and redo the fractional subtraction.

skills.name: Simplify to Lowest Terms
skills.definition: Reduce a resulting fraction to its lowest-terms equivalent by dividing numerator and denominator by their greatest common factor.

skills.name: Normalize Improper Fractional Part
skills.definition: When a mixed number's fractional part has numerator equal to or greater than its denominator, convert the excess into additional whole units before/while subtracting.

skills.name: Same-Denominator Pure-Fraction Subtraction
skills.definition: Subtract the numerators directly of two fractions with no whole-number part once they share a common denominator.
